Mailbox Communication Test Utility (AWR294X, AWR2544 and AWR2x44P)

Mailbox Communication Test Utility: This utility provides an example for message exchange between MSS/DSS and BSS. This test specifically issues version command to BSS in a loop of ten and prints the response from BSS on console.

This test case is a simple example to provide the usage mailbox driver API's for communicating with BSS.

In this test case:

  • MSS/DSS comes out of reset and initializes mailbox driver.
  • Wait for the BSS to Powerup.
  • MSS/DSS writes Version command to BSS mailbox memory.
  • Prints the version of HW and Firmware on console.
